lookback_summary: Well, well, well, the model had a mixed bag this weekend! It absolutely nailed the Nott'm Forest vs Arsenal fixture, predicting a Not Home outcome and seeing Arsenal take the win away. But then, it had to eat humble pie on the Tottenham vs Coventry City match, where it thought Coventry would hold their ground, only to see Spurs triumph at home. Talk about a rollercoaster of predictions!
